pageSections.title: A notebook can expose the complete machine-learning study
pageSections.description: The Alzheimer MRI Colab notebook preserves the actual order of the work: loading data, inspecting images, building a TensorFlow pipeline, training a CNN, and comparing later variants.
pageSections.context: That sequence makes each experimental decision easier to inspect.

pageSections.title: The experiment stays legible from input to evaluation
pageSections.description: The notebook records the work in execution order.
pageSections.markdown:
The notebook preserves data loading, visual inspection, preprocessing, model definition, training, evaluation, and the first comparison experiments.

A reviewer can follow the study from MRI input inspection through dataset partitioning, augmentation, TensorFlow model definition, and ensemble comparison without reconstructing the process from separate artifacts.

pageSections.title: What the artifact supports, and what it does not
pageSections.description: This is not a clinical product, and it should not be presented as one.
pageSections.markdown:
The repository preserves the experimental sequence needed for technical review. A reader can see what data is loaded, how the TensorFlow pipeline is assembled, how the convolutional baseline is trained, and where comparison extensions enter the study.

The artifact does not provide the guarantees of a broader benchmark, formal study protocol, or production-grade training package. Its value is a faithful record of how the experiment was carried out and where its scope ends.
